instruction: I want to enable loop/repeat mode in VLC so that videos automatically replay when they finish. How can I configure VLC to loop videos by default?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
